description: An HTML source file for a web-based database dashboard interface, including styles and client-side scripts for browsing databases, tables, and data with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, updating the sidebar content.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database, loading its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data as an HTML table within the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates an HTML cell for a given data value, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
